text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!!

Fine Motion, who was highly capable to begin with.
Through spring and this summer training camp, her abilities continued to grow by leaps and bounds—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Umm... "Senpai"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, thank you for running alongside me today♪
Thanks to you, I had a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
No way... You're not even out of breath...

She had become able to easily hold her own even against the senior Umamusume.
Her growth was far beyond what anyone had imagined...
choice_data_list: (She's... going to grow so much more!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it, Trainer?
Your eyes are sparkling so brightly—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
That voice just now...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Dammit, my pace isn't picking up...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, not this way, huh.
Then next is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You know, I love the look of Shakur's profile whenever she's deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Usually, people notice right away and find it annoying, though!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, shall we move on to the next training session?
I have to give it my all too!
choice_data_list: Let's take a break before that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there you are!
Lady Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, and you are...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just a reporter, though!
Man, your success is making huge waves!
You're the mega-huge favorite for the Shuka Sho, aren't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, I'm honored.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, heheh, she's strong and beautiful,
and on top of that, watching her run just brightens your mood!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Really, that's amazing!
What do you think? How about a photo—"

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"—Excuse me,
would you please direct interview requests through the Academy?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Are you an escort!?
Just as expected! It looks super photogenic, so
would you mind taking a photo with me?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair stealing a march on me!
In that case, mine too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"We're from the TV station! We're doing a live broadcast,
so would you mind giving us a quick interview?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Total chaos.
I'm really the heavy favorite, huh~
choice_data_list: Is this really the time to be saying that!?
Is this really the time to be saying that!?

text_block_list.text: Before long, spectators will start gathering. The training camp is still ongoing. For the other girls' sake, and above all for hers, I'd like to ask them politely to leave, but...
Now that it's come to this...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Your Highness and Trainer, please head inside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us meet again in a formal setting
next time, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When you suddenly mentioned "strength," I thought for a moment
you were going to put on a big action scene for us.

However, making a clumsy move myself might only cause more trouble.
It's best to leave it to the professionals.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't pathetic at all, you know?
In fact, it was a good decision.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can always rely on someone level-headed.
It means I've fallen for you all over again, you know? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was too slow!
Lady Fine, over here too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: There's a crazy crowd over there, isn't there? Is some celebrity visiting or something?

Even while trying to think of how to handle the situation,
the commotion only grew louder.
So, reacting on pure instinct—
choice_data_list: Please go home for now! I'm begging you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: ...I should get to Her Highness while I can.

Addressing the gathered reporters, I explained
that we could not accept interviews right now,
and that this summer is an important period—

I promised them I'd make time for an interview after
the camp. So I kept insisting they leave for now.

And so—several dozen minutes later,
thanks to the cooperation of the bodyguards,
we managed to get everyone to head home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You startled me when you shouted out like that all of a sudden.
Did you come up with some secret plan?
choice_data_list: I thought maybe you'd understand if I told you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
You truly believe in people, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
While that is a virtue, please leave situations like that to us first.
That is what your escort is for.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, with the way you handled things, Trainer,
I think it made a great impression on the press.
It should make things easier for us going forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Above all, you looked really cool, you know?
Thanks for your hard work!
